data.name: Maidul
data.gender_notes: Maidul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maidul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mahadool', which means 'Great Moon'. This name is associated with the calming and peaceful energy of the Moon, and is believed to bring tranquility and emotional balance. The name Maidul carries the meaning “Moon God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Maidul usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Maidul is a divine name, associated with the Hindu deity Ganesha, who is represented by the moon in his third eye. This name is believed to bestow wisdom, knowledge, and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Maidul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maidul total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
